overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the run detects 4 of 5 positive segments with no false alarms; at all identified confidence levels it detects all 5 positive segments.

overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first scoring gives 4 true positives, 2 false negatives, and no false positives; the authority-bias mechanism is credited despite the confirmation-bias label.

main_strengths: Clustering illusion, probability/base-rate neglect, and hindsight bias are correctly labeled, localized, and mechanistically supported.
All identified findings localize to positive segments and none produce a negative-segment false alarm.
The authority-bias evidence is accurately quoted and its underlying mechanism is fully captured despite the label error.

overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has strong segment localization and no false alarms, but strict instance performance is limited by one taxonomy error and one missed target. The mechanism-first score is materially higher, indicating that the main residual issue is label selection rather than failure to recover the authority-bias reasoning.
